message.content:
The three-digit integers ending in \(0\) range from \(100\) to \(990\), giving \(90\) possible values.

Let \(N=10k\), where \(k\) ranges from \(10\) to \(99\). Then
\[
4 \mid N \iff 4 \mid 10k \iff 2 \mid 5k \iff k \text{ is even}.
\]
Among the integers \(10,11,\dots,99\), exactly half are even, so there are \(45\) favorable outcomes out of \(90\).

Thus the probability is
\[
\frac{45}{90}=\frac12.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\frac12}\).
